notes: Added missing schema/contract, core logic hardening, and test coverage stories for Consent Framework.

change_log.value: Consent data schema and storage contract

SHARED-F-2-S136.title: Consent Data Schema and Storage Contract
SHARED-F-2-S136.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and Pydantic models for consent records, including tier level, anonymization flags, timestamps, and linkage to session/lead identifiers.

SHARED-F-2-S137.title: Consent Tier Enforcement Logic
SHARED-F-2-S137.description: Implement strict enforcement logic within consent_service to gate data storage and processing based on Tier 1 (de-identified) vs Tier 2 (identified) consent, including Safe Harbor de-identification validation.

SHARED-F-2-S138.title: Consent Framework Test Suite
SHARED-F-2-S138.description: Create unit and integration tests validating consent capture, tier enforcement, de-identification behavior, and API responses, including negative cases (missing consent, invalid tier transitions).
